key_insight: OPSD-V makes few-step autoregressive video generators stay coherent over long rollouts by self-distilling from long-video context during post-training. It improves long-horizon motion quality without changing the original fast inference path.
problem_solved: Few-step AR video generators are efficient, but quality often degrades over long sequences due to error accumulation and weaker motion dynamics. This paper targets long-horizon drift while preserving low-latency generation.
method: Uses on-policy self-distillation during post-training for few-step autoregressive video diffusion models.
Introduces real long-video data as temporal context to guide the model toward more stable long-range predictions.
Keeps the original few-step inference path unchanged, so the model remains fast at test time.
Trains the model to better maintain motion consistency and reduce accumulated generation errors across long rollouts.
impact: This matters for practitioners building fast video generators because it offers a way to improve long-video quality without sacrificing inference speed. It can make AR video models more practical for real-time and extended-content generation.

paper_title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
paper_authors: Hongyu Liu, Chun Wang, Feng Gao, Xuanhua He, Yue Ma
